node.title: Re^2: Optionally / safely disabling a warning category for a complete package (magic numbers)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [tye],

You're absolutely right that magic numbers are not good, that is a potential weakness of my proposed solutions.

FWIW, when the postderef feature was taken out of experimental status, it was elected to leave the "experimental::postderef" warnings category in place but to make it a no-op. References: [http://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/commit/2ad792cd4e9684519736fe03fd28a706b71ceda3|commit], [http://www.nntp.perl.org/group/perl.perl5.porters/2015/07/msg229274.html|P5P]

Regards,
-- Hauke D
